      match result.2 with
      | some found => some (offset 1 found)
      | none => if addHit state t then some (0, t) else none)

name: Solidity.Frontend.ExpressionUniqueness.binaryMarker
source_signature:
def binaryMarker (rank : Nat) : Tok → Bool
  | .punct .or => decide (rank = 2)
  | .punct .and => decide (rank = 3)
  | .punct .equal | .punct .notEqual => decide (rank = 4)
  | .punct .lt | .punct .gt | .punct .le | .punct .ge => decide (rank = 5)
  | .punct .bitOr => decide (rank = 6)
  | .punct .bitXor => decide (rank = 7)
  | .punct .bitAnd => decide (rank = 8)
  | .punct .shl | .punct .sar | .punct .shr => decide (rank = 9)
  | .punct .add | .punct .sub => decide (rank = 10)
  | .punct .mul | .punct .div | .punct .mod => decide (rank = 11)
  | .punct .exp => decide (rank = 12)
  | _ => false

def tokenLiteralKind : Tok → Option Nat
  | .bool _ => some 0
  | .num _ => some 1
  | .str _ => some 2
  | .hexStr _ => some 3
  | .unicodeStr _ => some 4
  | _ => none

    (items : List (List Tok)) (h : (Syn.unaryPrefix op e).yield initial = some (items, rest)) :
    ∃ xs, e.yield initial = some (xs, rest) ∧ items = [op.punct ++ xs.flatten]

theorem suffix_yield_parts (op : SuffixOp) (e : Syn .expr) (initial rest : List Choice)
    (items : List (List Tok)) (h : (Syn.unarySuffix op e).yield initial = some (items, rest)) :
    ∃ xs, e.yield initial = some (xs, rest) ∧ items = [xs.flatten ++ pu op.punct]
